task: lumina-v1-finish Phase 03 — auth & account lifecycle hardening

snippets.description: Shared passwordSchema (min 10, max 128, length only), changePasswordSchema (rejects new == current), resetPasswordSchema (strict: newPassword only)
refreshCookieOptions(env): httpOnly, sameSite lax, secure only in production, path /api/v1/auth, maxAge
revokeUserRefreshTokens: sets revoked_at on every non-revoked token of a user
pruneRefreshTokens: deletes expired rows and rows revoked more than 7 days ago; per-user when userId given
Total, never-throwing limiter key generators: login ip+sha256(email), refresh ip+sha256(cookie) prefix, change-password ip+sha256(user.sub)
issueSession: inserts the hashed refresh token, then setCookie with refreshCookieOptions
pruneAfterAuth: awaited per-user prune in try/catch; hourly global sweep fire-and-forget with caught error
Per-IP ceiling via app.createRateLimit (RATE_LIMIT_MAX) run first in preHandler; route-level config.rateLimit with hook preHandler and AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX
POST /auth/change-password: authenticate, caller active, verify current (400 INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD), one transaction update+revoke, issueSession after commit, activity user.password_changed
PATCH /users/:id revokes refresh tokens when status moves away from active
POST /users/:id/reset-password: admin only, self-reset 400, unknown 404, transaction update+revoke, activity user.password_reset, never echoes password
AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX default 30; superRefine rejects empty, '*', or non-http(s) CORS_ORIGIN when NODE_ENV=production
isDemoMode() renders a static explainer card; the form (and any API call) only mounts outside demo mode
Reset password action hidden in demo mode (admin-only page)
Reset password action: admin and !isDemoMode() only
Reset password action: admin and !isDemoMode() only
resetPersonPassword: local branch returns fail(...), API branch calls resetUserPassword
